crossRefs.note: They came to Ophir, and fetched from there gold, four hundred and twenty talents, and brought it to king Solomon.
It can’t be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.

people.name: Ophir
people.line: A region known for its gold

translations.web: even three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, with which to overlay the walls of the houses;
